game.desc: Family Guy: Back to the Multiverse is an action game for Xbox 360. Based on the Family Guy series, you play as Brian and Stewie who have to cross several universes in order to foil the plans of the adorable toddler's evil twin. Mixing trashy humour and self-mockery, the title offers many nods to the show via several characters well known to fans.
